'''2017 European Championship Day 2 David Luhaær DS Bring Him Before Me''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[David Luhaær]] at [[2017 European Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[David Luhaær]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 European Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
